scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: MTFM：美团统一推荐基座大模型在外卖多业务场景的落地实践
papers.abstract: 美团在 MTGR 基础上提出统一推荐基座大模型 MTFM，首次实现外卖多个主要业务的统一精排模型。
papers.summary: 美团面向外卖多业务精排，提出统一推荐基座 MTFM，以异构 Tokenizer、动态掩码和混合注意力共享用户行为建模，保留业务独立任务塔。官方实践报告显示，多业务订单量提升 2.06%–6.68%，推理成本下降 24%；Target 与 Full Attention 按 3:1 堆叠时，样本吞吐达到全注意力架构的 2.9 倍。
papers.key_insight: 社区帖子、问答和评论可共用用户长短期行为编码，同时保留各场景 CTR 任务塔和独立特征入口。最值得借鉴的是用户粒度训练与曝光时间掩码：前者复用长序列计算，后者防止未来点击泄漏；上线前需单独验证社区搜索 nDCG，不能把外卖订单增幅直接外推。
papers.preference_reason: 商业相关评分不低于4，符合用户偏好的业务相关维度；主题奖励为0。

papers.title: When LLM-Based User Profiling Adds Value in Production Streaming Recommendation
papers.authors: Milad Sabouri, Neeraj Sharma, Sardar Hamidian, Shaghayegh Agah
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.27183v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Personalized recommendation depends critically on how user representations are constructed from historical behavior. Two paradigms have emerged for constructing semantic user profiles in content-based recommendation. First, aggregate methods derive user representations as numerical aggregates of semantic item embeddings. Second, LLM-based methods generate natural-language summaries of user preferences and encode them through a text encoder. Each paradigm can be combined with temporal disentanglement of recent versus historical behavior. LLM-based profile generation is significantly more expensive than aggregate approaches, raising the question of when this additional cost is justified. We present a systematic comparison of four semantic user-profiling strategies, factorially crossed across representation type and temporal handling, evaluated on a real-world production dataset. The comparison reveals how these strategies differ across use
papers.summary: 论文在真实流媒体数据上比较聚合向量与 LLM 画像，并交叉测试长短期兴趣拆分，共评估 4 种策略、1 万名用户和约 24 万个内容。全体用户中，长短期聚合向量使 NDCG@10 相对提升 4.7%；LLM 整体画像在探索型用户中提升 31.5%，但在总体上下降 26.9%，收益明显依赖人群。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索可先用历史点击内容的语义均值作用户特征，再检验 LLM 画像是否只对兴趣变化人群有效。论文中的探索型标签利用未来测试行为，不能直接作为线上路由；还需评估目录覆盖与新颖性，避免个体列表更丰富、全站内容曝光却更集中的现象。
papers.preference_reason: 商业相关评分不低于4，符合用户偏好的业务相关维度；主题奖励为0。

papers.title: Tie Handling Is Part of the Evaluation Protocol: An Order-Invariance Audit for Tie-Heavy Recommender Scores
papers.authors: Chengkun Guo, Han Chen, Yilin Zhu, Yingrui Li
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.26977v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Offline top-k evaluation often ranks one held-out relevant item together with sampled negatives. When several candidates receive exactly the same score, the tie-breaking rule becomes part of the ranking. A common implementation stores the relevant item first and then applies a stable sort, which preserves input order among equal scores; the relevant item therefore wins every tie. We call an evaluator row-order invariant when permuting the input candidates without changing their identities, labels, or scores leaves the final ranking unchanged. We audit this property by holding candidates and scores fixed and changing only the tie-breaking rule. On 30,000 Amazon Beauty & Personal Care rows, NDCG@10 for a rating-weighted attribute-overlap score is 0.85 under input-order tie-breaking. A deterministic hash tie-break based on user and item IDs lowers it to 0.17. The exact expectation under uniform random tie-breaking closely matches the mean o
papers.summary: 论文审计推荐评测中的同分排序：正样本若固定排在首位，稳定排序会让其赢得全部平局。在 3 万条 Amazon Beauty 评测记录上，仅把输入顺序打破平局改为用户与物品 ID 哈希排序，NDCG@10 就从 0.85 降至 0.17；均匀随机平局的精确期望与 100 个哈希种子的均值吻合。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索的 nDCG 验证应加入候选行随机置换检查，尤其关注量化分数、规则召回及稀疏交互模型中的大量同分。固定用户与内容 ID 的哈希次序可提高重复性，但还应报告平局比例和随机平局期望，区分真实模型改进与排序实现造成的指标虚高。
papers.preference_reason: 商业相关评分不低于4，符合用户偏好的业务相关维度；主题奖励为0。

papers.title: Beyond a Scalar: Distributional Serving Interfaces for Watch-Time Prediction
papers.authors: Xuan Liu, Jingbin Qian, Zhanyu Liu, Hefeng Zhou
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.28383v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Watch time is the primary engagement signal in short video feeds, and its prediction directly affects ranking and exposure. Existing methods improve watch time prediction by correcting duration bias or modeling richer distributions, but most expose only an expected or debiased watch time at serving time. Even when video duration is available to later models, the interface gives only one estimate of watch time and no probabilities for completion, overplay, or other regions relevant to downstream tasks. To address this limitation, we propose the Distributional Serving Interface (DSI), which has a distribution provider, a compact, low-dimensional summary, and lightweight readouts tailored to each task. The provider learns a joint distribution over four watch states derived from watch ratio and their event times; rules based on video duration remove incompatible combinations, while a restoration loss preserves accuracy in seconds. The summar
papers.summary: DSI 针对观看时长单一预测值丢失行为分布的问题，输出观看状态概率、相对时长和不确定性摘要，再接轻量任务读出层。在 KuaiRec 上，MAE 从最强基线的 3.8327 秒降至 3.5059 秒；三个公开数据集相对降幅为 1.9%–8.5%。固定读出层后增益缩小，说明完整系统优势不能全部归因于分布接口。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索若兼顾 CTR、阅读完成和停留时长，可以保留分布摘要供各任务使用，减少新增目标时反复重训主模型。实验表明 27 维摘要能保留均值之外的信息，但不同分布参数化效果相近；应先固定读出层做对照，再判断复杂状态设计是否值得部署。

papers.title: Calibrating Reproduced Claims in Recommender Systems
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.26975v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reproduction studies can produce mixed outcomes. Reported values may differ while the ordering of the compared methods remains the same, a result may hold only under some experimental conditions, or a released implementation may fail to reproduce a result that the model can still reach. The terms repeatability, reproducibility, and replicability describe how a follow-up study relates to the original experiment, but not which parts of the original claim are supported by the new results. We introduce \emph{claim calibration} as a way of stating the strongest claim supported by a follow-up study, together with the conditions under which it holds and the parts that remain untested. We apply this perspective to five original--follow-up paper pairs from recommender-systems research. The cases show that agreement in numerical values, method rankings, statistical results, and overall conclusions does not always coincide, and that follow-up studi
papers.summary: 论文通过 5 对推荐系统原始研究与复现研究，分析数值一致、方法排序一致和结论成立之间的区别，提出 Claim Evidence Profile 记录主张及适用条件。例如一个复现案例增加 15 项指标，另一个增加 4 个数据集，比较范围因此发生变化。研究未重新运行实验，证据来自论文与公开材料的结构化分析。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索评审可同时记录原始收益、复现设置、可支持的结论和未验证部分，防止把一个数据切分上的 nDCG 改进写成普适收益。该工作适合改进排序模型评测报告和实验交接；它提供证据记录方法，不提供可直接承诺的 CTR 或线上业务增幅。
